summary.prose: Build S6 in 14 ordered tasks: trusted canonical/evidence adapters and recovery composition first, then the scoped bridge, qualified provider adapters, versioned client routing and truthful status. Finish with compatibility, rollout and evaluation evidence. Legacy remains the default; activation requires separate readiness and predecessor approval, and no live comparison or default change is included.

tasks.title: Define versioned commands status and disabled engine selection
tasks.summary: Add the exact sc7 status type, discriminated production command/diagnostic envelopes, errors and capability declarations in proposed src/shared/review-investigation.ts; add default-legacy selection/readiness configuration without enabling starts.
acceptanceChecks: Exact ReviewClientStatusV1 matches HLD; progress/usage diagnostics remain explicitly versioned outer fields.
Strict commands distinguish engine/version/operation and reject unknown fields/versions before dispatch; no client-supplied reviewer party is authoritative.
Default behavior remains legacy and a config value alone cannot enable investigation.

tests.name: Strict investigation commands status schema and default legacy selection

tasks.title: Adapt canonical approved work and exact commit scope
tasks.summary: Implement the daemon-owned verified WorkInputReader and scope/attestation adapter over existing registry and canonical lifecycle/history; feed sc1/sc2 without deriving scope from HEAD.
acceptanceChecks: Canonical integrity, approved revision and source bindings are checked; a present invalid PLAN cannot be bypassed by planless routing.
Planned and approved-upstream small/planless builds retain required criteria and all selected changed blocks.
Mixed/ambiguous attribution refuses or requires explicit verified scope evidence; Story trailers alone are not exclusivity proofs.

tests.name: Canonical approved planned and upstream scope rejects ambiguous attribution

tasks.title: Compose pinned evidence test and caller-impact adapters
tasks.summary: Add trusted bounded source/artifact/test-result reads and optional graph caller lookup tied to exact selected entities and registered dependency closure.
acceptanceChecks: Evidence identities derive from actual pinned reads and verified test records, never reviewer attestations or mutable markdown.
Source-only exposes no caller query; indexed lookup verifies source/index/entity mapping and retains partial/stale/unknown limitations.
Empty or partial caller results do not imply no impact; unresolved impact obligations remain required, with no client DB access.

tests.name: Pinned source artifact test and caller evidence preserve provenance and limitations

tasks.title: Build repository-owned admission and recovery composition service
tasks.summary: Add immutable private production descriptor discovery and one daemon service per registered repo, composing existing S1-S5 state, continuation and publication APIs.
acceptanceChecks: Exact repeated requestId reuses one run; conflicting inputs refuse and admission-orphan crashes cannot infer accepted work.
Descriptor records scope/mode/policy/backend/party identity under restrictive runtime paths without a second acceptance journal or private sc4 format changes.
Lease claim occurs when execution is admitted; resume/cancel/restart preserve accepted progress, budget and frozen publication semantics; no provider executes until a qualified adapter is injected.

Production descriptor and scoped bridge runtime material is excluded from explicit packet selection and source/context reads through the shared path guard; no sc4 private namespace or event format is altered.

tests.name: Idempotent admission descriptor recovery and runtime source exclusions
Service lease budget and frozen publication composition survive restart

tasks.title: Expose authenticated scoped evidence and progress bridge
tasks.summary: Implement the service bridge for read/impact/progress/final-reply calls, binding private capability authority to process epoch/run/subject/attempt/request/generation/role/expiry.
acceptanceChecks: The only reviewer operations reach trusted sc1/sc2 reads or validated sc3/sc4 progress/reply; no general RPC, shell, filesystem, approval or cross-repo capability.
Several blocks can be durably acknowledged before a final reply in one session; final deltas cannot bypass checkpoints.
Cross-run/stale/expired/revoked callbacks refuse, exact retries remain idempotent, and cancellation drains authority before reuse.

tests.name: Scoped bridge accepts multiple block ACKs and rejects stale cross run capabilities

tasks.title: Add native binding and effective-isolation qualification
tasks.summary: Extend shared provider options additively with the approved trusted investigation binding and common qualification records; preserve the existing no-binding review path.
acceptanceChecks: Qualification checks effective isolated tool/config catalogue, adapter/binary/profile identity, cancellation and scoped progress support rather than trusting a boolean or read-only sandbox.
Inherited user/project MCP, plugins/hooks, executable repo instructions and broad tools cannot enter a qualified session; OAuth is not copied or replaced.
Unsupported/unproven adapter versions refuse before a provider call; deterministic fake-CLI evidence is labelled and does not certify an installed binary.

tests.name: Effective native isolation qualification rejects inherited tools and unproven binaries

tasks.title: Integrate qualified Claude investigation sessions
tasks.summary: Implement the Claude-specific isolated invocation adapter behind LLMProvider/CliProvider using the common bridge and qualification boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Qualified invocation exposes only the scoped bridge and supports multiple per-block ACKs in one managed CLI session.
128K inclusive estimated admission includes actual schema/tool catalogue and reserves; internalRetry:false, 5-minute cap and abort/stall behavior retain existing owner accounting.
No-binding legacy/design invocation behavior remains unchanged; unqualified installed versions fail closed without broad-tool fallback or direct REST.

tests.name: Claude scoped session progress budget cancellation and legacy behavior

tasks.title: Integrate qualified Codex investigation sessions
tasks.summary: Implement the Codex-specific isolated invocation adapter through the same provider abstraction and bridge with independent effective-configuration qualification.
acceptanceChecks: Codex effective tool/config isolation is verified independently of a read-only sandbox; broad registered MCP/tools and executable startup context are not admitted.
One scoped session can accept multiple durable blocks; full reply validation, budget, retry and cancellation behavior match the common domain.
Unsupported installed versions refuse explicitly; existing no-binding Codex/design behavior and CLI OAuth ownership remain unchanged.

tests.name: Codex scoped session progress budget cancellation and legacy behavior

tasks.title: Route controller MCP and daemon commands by pinned engine
tasks.summary: Register additive production IPC/MCP operations and route explicit new-engine calls before legacy resolution; adapt authenticated controller turns and fresh declared budgets to the same service.
acceptanceChecks: Daemon/controller x source/indexed x planned/planless use the same subject, evidence, progress, recovery and completion service.
Controller replies cannot supply author identity, forge inspection receipts or reuse cross-engine/schema/generation tokens; budgets are declared estimates, not measured host context.
Existing legacy/predecessor/design handlers retain valid original frames and states; new-engine errors never fall through to legacy execution or HEAD diff.

tests.name: Entry parity across daemon controller source and indexed planned and planless runs
Cross engine schema generation and capability replay are rejected

tasks.title: Project truthful status reconnect and usage diagnostics
tasks.summary: Implement one sc7 serializer and bounded status/heartbeat projections across transports, using verified recovery and the existing qualified idempotent usage writer/outbox.
acceptanceChecks: Covered/required/unresolved and latest block/checkpoint differ explicitly from provider liveness; detach is no verdict or automatic retry.
Observed, estimated, reserved, pending and unavailable usage remain distinct; unknown counters stay null and cumulative snapshots are not double counted.
Legacy status uses labelled diagnostic units and unavailable/non-resumable states without fabricating an investigation journal; status reads consume no execution allowance.

tests.name: Status reconnect progress accounting and pending unknown usage are truthful

tasks.title: Verify end-to-end recovery cancellation and canonical publication
tasks.summary: Integrate production start/read/progress/reply/status/resume/cancel through real domain and canonical stores with deterministic provider/controller fixtures.
acceptanceChecks: Per-block ACKs survive provider/transport/daemon interruption; exact concurrent retries converge and late/revoked replies cannot create a terminal result.
Pinned source/contracts/BUILD/party changes and edited canonical heads refuse; frozen lost-ACK publication reconciles without rerunning judgments.
Incomplete/failed execution produces no successful CR while accountable WARN/BLOCK findings and pending usage remain intact.

tests.name: Crash concurrent resume cancel and frozen publication recover without duplicate execution

tasks.title: Implement explicit adoption rollback and predecessor reconciliation gate
tasks.summary: Add readiness policy and schema/guide documentation; prepare the supported tracked predecessor code-only reconciliation for separate explicit approval, without rewriting sibling LLDs.
acceptanceChecks: Readiness requires compatible readers/client/daemon, real qualified backend, version-pinned evidence and approved predecessor reconciliation; missing/draft evidence keeps starts disabled.
Both S005 installation orders and valid pre-S005/legacy/design routes remain compatible; only predecessor code-only chunk/gather/new frames are superseded at adoption.

Rollback rejects new investigation work, safely pauses/drains current turns and preserves compatible status/export/cancel/frozen publication reconciliation; unsupported older resumes refuse without conversion.
Preparing the reconciliation never auto-approves it or enables opt-in; record any pending external approval explicitly.

tests.name: Legacy S005 pre S005 design and installation order partitions remain compatible
Opt in readiness and rollback retain status while refusing unsupported resumes

tasks.title: Add independently adjudicated deterministic quality and baseline evaluation
tasks.summary: Implement versioned fixture/oracle and recorded-baseline comparison for required defects/coverage plus labelled call/time/repeated-input metrics and readiness evidence hashes.
acceptanceChecks: Fixture oracle provenance is independently adjudicated; baseline and candidate records bind source/policy/schema/adapter/fixture identity and required coverage/defects cannot silently disappear.
Deterministic/provider-script metrics are labelled and unknown actual tokens/latency stay unavailable; no per-iteration full legacy review or live model run is required.
Passing deterministic evaluation can support explicit opt-in only alongside all other gates; no default quality/savings claim or default flip without separately authorized live evidence and decision.

tests.name: Adjudicated fixture baseline preserves required defects coverage and labelled efficiency metrics
No default quality or savings claim without separately authorized live evidence

tasks.title: Prove installation rollout matrix and complete focused verification
tasks.summary: Run the final daemon/controller/source/index/planned/planless/native/legacy installation matrix, actual adapter qualification diagnostics, focused suites and production build; retain required sequence documentation and one final independent code review.
acceptanceChecks: Matrix covers capability mismatch, both installation orders, scope ambiguity, unknown impact/usage, concurrency, crash/reconnect and rollback without legacy/design regressions.
Installed adapter qualification is reported truthfully; an unsupported binary or pending reconciliation leaves opt-in closed rather than manufacturing readiness.

Focused affected suites and production build pass without whole-repo/live sweeps; record logs in /tmp, update relevant diagram if integration changes its boundaries, and run exactly one mandatory independent code review before asking BUILD completion approval.
Final BUILD distinguishes completed implementation from activation readiness, listing any unsupported installed adapter or separately pending reconciliation approval explicitly.

tests.name: Installed adapter and activation readiness remain explicit across the final matrix
Focused production integration domain legacy provider fixtures and production build
